scoring_justification: Peak electric field is deterministic for the given geometry and bias; the paper reports ~2.0 V·nm⁻¹. Scoring closeness with tolerance accommodates meshing/solver differences without requiring a full FEM recompute in the verifier.

hidden_assets.purpose: Reference peak electric field value from the paper (2.0 V·nm⁻¹ for gap=0.6 nm, bias=10 V).
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper: Nano Research (2013) DOI:10.1007/s12274-013-0355-1, Section 2.4, Fig. 5, 'peak field of ~2 V·nm⁻¹'. Finite element analysis with COMSOL 4.3a.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Direct extraction from paper text and figure caption.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: This number is explicitly reported in the paper as the result of the FEM simulation used to estimate the electrostatic field threshold for fluorine reduction.

outputs.description: Peak electric field magnitude at the graphene fluoride surface under the AFM tip apex for a 0.6 nm gap and 10 V substrate bias. Compared to the paper-reported value within a tolerance.

output_contract.notes: Only the computational electrostatic simulation is reproduced; wet-lab fabrication and transport data are not code-verifiable.
